name: vav_fan_simulation
title: Variable-speed fan from dimensionless polynomials
summary: Predicts the pressure rise, shaft power and electrical power of a fan below catalogue speed, using catalogue quadratics of the dimensionless pressure and power coefficients and part-load motor and VFD efficiencies. Air enters only as the constant density 1.2 kg/m³.
